items.title: Execution-realism and market-state evidence
items.goal: Extend research with timestamp-safe spread, slippage, funding history, basis, open-interest changes, liquidation context and execution-cost evidence without fabricating unavailable data.
acceptance: new evidence is timestamp-safe and fail-closed
backtests model realistic costs and do not assume perfect fills
research-only features cannot authorize live trades
deterministic regression tests pass

items.title: Cross-sectional relative-strength prediction
items.goal: Research rank-based prediction across the liquid universe so the system can compare assets against peers and BTC rather than relying only on isolated absolute-direction forecasts.
acceptance: rank features use only information available at decision time
chronological train/validation/untouched OOS remains enforced
realistic trading costs are included
no live promotion occurs from research output

items.title: Regime-specialist research models
items.goal: Separate strategy evidence by bull trend, bear trend, range, high-volatility stress and compression regimes, with explicit minimum-sample and stability requirements.
acceptance: regime labels are computed without lookahead
each promoted research claim has adequate regime sample size
performance is reported by regime and untouched OOS
weak or missing regime evidence remains RESEARCH_ONLY

items.title: Calibrated ensemble champion/challenger weighting
items.goal: Combine independently validated strategies using longitudinal OOS/calibration evidence, penalizing correlation, deterioration and unstable parameter dependence rather than selecting raw historical return winners.
acceptance: ensemble weighting is based on validated historical evidence only
correlated strategies do not receive naive additive confidence
deteriorating strategies can be demoted automatically
registry cannot bypass promotion signatures

items.title: Broader high-quality market data coverage
items.goal: Increase reliable exchange and market-state coverage while preserving freshness, timestamp normalization, liquidity filters and explicit unavailable states.
acceptance: every source has provenance and freshness metadata
stale or contradictory data fails closed
batching/caching bounds latency and API cost
PONS and broad liquid-universe handling remain safe

items.title: Continuous forecast scoring and deterioration detection
items.goal: Use the append-only prediction ledger to identify strategy, feature, regime and asset deterioration after outcomes become due, without hindsight relabeling.
acceptance: outcomes use first eligible data at or after fixed due_at
scoring cannot change historical prediction labels
weak calibration can only restrict signals
deterioration evidence is surfaced to registry/risk review

items.title: Expanded adversarial strategy destruction tests
items.goal: Systematically stress promising strategies across exchanges, periods, parameter perturbations, fees, slippage, bootstraps, malformed data and regime shifts before any promotion review.
acceptance: tests explicitly target overfitting and leakage
failure paths produce WAIT or RESEARCH_ONLY
robustness evidence remains deterministic and sealed
promotion gates stay unchanged or become stricter
